title: 谢雨卿的文章
author: Xie Yuqing (Carl)
description: 谢雨卿的文章：聊历史，聊经济，也聊城市和日常。公众号“谢雨聊”的文章都在这里。
english_description: Essays on everyday life, learning, and society. Chinese writing and English practice by Xie Yuqing (Carl).
article_description: 2026年10月之前的文章大多首发于微信公众号，之后的文章首发于本网站。
article_english_description: Most of the articles before October 2026 were first published on the WeChat official account, while the subsequent articles were first published on this website.
